steps.prompt: What is the last line of a speech, song or film that stayed with you? Why did it stick?

cards.title: Sum up
cards.body: After the restated thesis, a sentence or two sum up the main points. Keep it short; no new reasons or evidence.

cards.title: Leave a final thought
cards.body: End with something that stays with the reader: a call to act (“Let’s…”), a look ahead (“If we…, next year…”), a question, or an image (“Imagine…”). Never “Thank you for reading.”

cards.title: A full conclusion
cards.text: A community garden would make our school a better place to learn and eat. It would turn science lessons into real experiments and put fresh food on our plates. Let’s ask the principal for a small plot of land this spring.
cards.note: Restated thesis → summary → call to action. The essay map marks all three.

prompts: Which kind of final thought did you choose? Why does it fit?
Read your conclusion aloud. Does it feel finished?
